name: Rowan's father
description: The dead king who appears in Rowan's dream, giving her his crown.

timeline.summary: Rowan dreams of a feast where her parents give her their crown and tell her to come to Castle Ardenvale; she wakes resolved to go.
timeline.quote: "Come to Castle Ardenvale. Your blood awaits you there."
